question: In which of the following years did the Government of India appoint the Saddler University Commission to analyse the problems of the Calcutta University?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1917.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saddler Commission** was set up in **1917** to **study and report on problems of Calcutta University**.
 
• It analysed the conditions prevailing in the educational system and suggested some measures, submitting its report in 1919.
 
• It recommended a separate board for secondary and intermediate education
 
• It stated that the improvement of secondary education was a necessary condition for the improvement of University education.
 
• It recommended that Universities should be freed from excessive official control.
 
• It stressed the teacher education and organising the teaching staff.
 
• It also recommended the provision of a three-year degree course after the intermediate stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Woods Despatch (1854)**

 
 
• It is called the Magna Carta of education in India.
 
• It is the first major policy that advocated the system of education at various levels and in an organised manner.
 
 
 
• **Hunter Commission (1882-83)**
 
 
• Its recommendations are mainly related to primary and secondary education.
